direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px/52px/1fr/56px, cols 184px/1fr/360px at 1366x768; FactoryStage >=55vw and >=60vh, Inspector internal-scroll only, DecisionBar pinned, no page scroll
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705; panel #0B100B; raised #121A12; silver #C5CCD4 headings/machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68); border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary #A8F04A on #050705, one per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D only for stopped/offline CELL-MILL-2 outline, OFFLINE/STOPPED text and cross-hatch; logo immutable black/emerald/neon-green/brushed-silver, native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolor/crop/redraw/add elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction plus one status sentence per step
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection/panel; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops/pulses/glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while preserving pattern, marker and text
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room button; StepRail from single steps array, 9 steps plus completion, 36-40px aria-current buttons, remove dead Workspaces disclosures; GuideStrip 52px without duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px separating pre-flight nonce/identity route health from investigation evidence task; consent opens on selecting a recovery option; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre, one primary right; skip-to-stage first, then header>rail>guide>SVG nodes>inspector>DecisionBar, arrows in rail/SVG, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite for results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only, silver idle, neon feasible/accepted, red only stopped CELL-MILL-2, never route through offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 vs Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning gap; bidirectional SVG-inspector highlight; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern+marker+text; pending proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, blocked prior tasks coexisting with approved recovery plan while replacements await approval

fixes.change: Remove the extra official logo at the stage/inspector junction; keep only the required header and opening-story placements.
Expand the collapsed 'Inspect source evidence' control into visible certificate/receiving excerpts linked bidirectionally to the 120 vs 80 SVG tracks.
Give RECEIVING, CELL-MILL-1/2 and JOB-1001/1002 keyboard focus, names and inspector sync; add 2px #A8F04A focus outline.
Separate ROUTE HEALTH PRE-FLIGHT into nonce/identity rows with Pass/Fail text, distinct from the Run Sample investigation evidence task below it.
Label the route selector with result state: Sample selected means no live call and no result yet; keep primary text 'Run Sample investigation'.
Reduce repeated offline explanation to one status sentence so inspector fits 768px without crowding the primary.
Pin the opened typed consent form while the three-option comparison scrolls internally; keep exact phrase, plan identifier and character count visible.
Show why Accept is disabled until exact match, and announce match state via aria-live without enabling early.
Add finish/incremental column headers to all option cards and a selected marker plus text, not outline alone.
Keep t1-t3 explicitly 'PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL' and suppress tracked-task metrics until Approve is pressed.
Make Decline proposal a text-labelled secondary in DecisionBar area, separated from the single Approve primary.
Link each proposed task to its JOB bay on the SVG so hovering/focusing t1-t3 highlights the affected route.
In preview, render CELL-MILL-2 with owner-required red outline, cross-hatch and 'PREVIEW STOPPED - not applied' text; inspector must still read ONLINE until applied.
Move 'Will invalidate acceptance' warning adjacent to the machine selector and repeat it in the DecisionBar beside Apply second shock.
Collapse Scenario Management admin control below the fold or into a labelled disclosure so the inspector fits at 1366x768.
Add a delta banner in the stage: CELL-MILL-2 24h available to OFFLINE, feasible paths 3 to 2, with pattern+text on the red stopped cell.
Separate pre-flight nonce/identity health from the reinvestigation task as in Step 2; do not present route health as investigation evidence.
Mark Split available capacity CONSTRAINED on both SVG chip and inspector state so changed capacity is readable without colour alone.
Keep revised typed consent pinned on selection, state 'Prior acceptance invalidated - fresh review required' inside the form, and disable Accept until exact phrase matches.
For CONSTRAINED Split, show unavailable finish/cost as em dashes with reason 'capacity changed' and remove it from keyboard selection order.
Tighten comparison card padding so consent input and remaining-character count are visible at 768px without inspector scroll hunting.
Expand the collapsed 'Prior tracked work - 3 BLOCKED' row by default on first arrival, showing coexistence with the approved revised plan and untracked replacements.
Ensure red stopped CELL-MILL-2 has no feasible route drawn through it; route accepted flow only through CELL-MILL-1.
Add due/dependency text focus order t1>t2>t3 matching visual order for keyboard approval review.
Sequence controls explicitly: passphrase > Seal encrypted packet > Verify ledger > Export independent checkpoint, disabling later steps until prerequisites complete.
Remove duplicate 'Verify ledger' primary from DecisionBar while it is also an inspector action; DecisionBar shows status until inspector action completes.
Correct task summary wording to reflect 3 tracked tasks state and show blocked/done counts with text markers, not colour.
Confirm this completion view contains no third logo placement beyond header and the opening-story placement; do not add a closing logo lockup.
Replace generic 'Review recovery proof' primary with terminal state summary 'Packet sealed - 18 events - revised plan accepted' and a Back/Restart text-labelled secondary.
Mask passphrase field value in any retained screenshot state and add 'Complete - current ledger' check plus text to Seal, Verify and Export rows consistently.
